alternateMatches.sovietText: Zionism, a Tool of Imperialism Zionism may be considered an economic, political and military corporation which has placed itself at the service of national exploiting classes, on the one hand, and world imperialism, especially US imperialism, on the other.

Of course, Western imperialist circles, above all those in the United States, try to present matters in such a way as to suggest that Israel “acted alone” when it started the war against the Arab states allegedly in order to defend the existence of the “peaceful refuge of the Jews” who had congregated at the hill of Zion with the aim of carrying out the behests of the Old Testament.

matches.echo_explanation: Both texts employ the identical argumentative strategy of portraying Zionism as a coordinated international conspiracy that controls or manipulates governments through organized Jewish influence networks.

sovietClaims: Modern Zionism is the ideology, the political practice, a whole network of organizations of the big Jewish bourgeoisie which has associated itself with the monopoly circles in the USA and other imperialist powers.
The influential Paris newspaper La Nation recently made an interesting observation.

At times one gets the impression that the state of Israel has in all Western countries where there are large Jewish communities unconditional allies ready to bring pressure to bear on the government of their country, to make it support Israeli politics in all cases, and denounce any government not yielding to this pressure.
There is much truth in this observation.
